description:
MiniMax H3 — next-gen multimodal video generation.

Modes determined by inputs:
- Text-to-video: prompt only (ratio required, no adaptive)
- Image-to-video: prompt + image (first frame)
- First-last frame: prompt + image + last_image
- Reference: prompt + reference images/videos/audio

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video content. Max 7000 chars.
examples: A cinematic aerial shot of a lighthouse at sunset, waves crashing against the rocky shore
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: First frame image for image-to-video. Formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC. Max 30MB.
image.title: Image

last_image.description: Last frame image. Requires image to be set as first frame.
last_image.title: Last Image

reference_images.description: Reference images for style/content guidance. Cannot combine with first/last frame.
reference_images.title: Reference Images

reference_video.description: Reference video for motion/style guidance. MP4/MOV, max 50MB, 2-15s.
reference_video.title: Reference Video

reference_audio.description: Reference audio for synchronized generation. WAV/MP3, max 15MB, 2-15s.
reference_audio.title: Reference Audio

ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Text-to-video requires a concrete value (not adaptive).

title: AppInput
